verdict.rationale: Algolia's core search platform is a closed-source hosted SaaS; community evidence explicitly cites 'closed source license' as a reason customers left (algolia-comm-5, algolia-comm-6). While peripheral tools like InstantSearch.js and CLI skills are open source (algolia-docs-8, algolia-docs-50), the core product source is not available under an open license, so an AI-native user cannot read the product's source.
